data.name: Vandana
data.gender_notes: Vandana is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root vand, 'to salute, praise' — vandanā, 'salutation'. Its root is Sanskrit vand (वन्द्). A classical Sanskrit term for salutation. Vandana is a Sanskrit name meaning “Salutation; worship; praise”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vandana expresses “Salutation; worship; praise”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root vand, 'to salute, praise' — vandanā, 'salutation'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vandana total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

vedic_reference.note: The name Vandana is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vandana', which means 'offering', 'giving', 'dedication', and 'praise'. It is also used in Hindu rituals to refer to the offering or invocation of the deity. The Vedic reference for this name is the Rigveda, where it is mentioned in various hymns as a form of devotion and worship.
